annotations.title: Edit, close or remove my job

description: Manage a job owned by the member: edit its title, type, location, apply link or description, close it, or permanently remove it. Editing a live or closed role returns it to moderation before it is public again. Requires the user’s confirmation.

confirmation_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: you get an action_summary and a token instead of the action. After the user explicitly confirms that summary, call again with the SAME arguments plus this token.

name: manage_job
